gloss: service entrance; side door; staff entrance

definitions.gloss: service entrance; side door; staff entrance; back entrance
definitions.explanation: A secondary entrance to a building, typically used by staff, deliveries, or for everyday access rather than the main entrance.

examples.japanese: {通用口|つうようぐち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please enter through the service entrance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{配達|はいたつ}→配達：00084_haitatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{通用口|つうようぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please use the service entrance for deliveries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正面|しょうめん}→正面：13189_shoumen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入|い}り{口|ぐち}→入り口：02507_iriguchi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{閉|し}まっていた→閉まる：00754_shimaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{通用口|つうようぐち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: The front entrance was closed, so I entered the building through the side door.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{通用|つうよう}→通用：04530_tsuuyou⟧ (general use, common use) + {口|ぐち} (entrance, opening). Refers to a door used for everyday or practical access, as opposed to the formal main entrance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通用口|つうようぐち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter through the service entrance
- {通用口|つうようぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use the service entrance
- ⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{通用口|つうようぐち}: the back service entrance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {正面玄関|しょうめんげんかん}: main entrance — the formal front entrance of a building
- ⟦{裏口|うらぐち}→裏口：04101_uraguchi⟧: back door — a door at the rear, sometimes with connotations of doing things secretly
- ⟦{非常口|ひじょうぐち}→非常口：07045_hijouguchi⟧: emergency exit — used only in emergencies
